hook.name: MemeowGuardHook
hook.description: Per-pool launch-protection hook for meme token pools: anti-snipe buy caps and extra LP fees during a configurable window (with optional linear decay), surge fees on large buys, optional auto-burn of coin output, and a volatility-based EWMA dynamic fee. Also custodies on-chain single-tick limit orders and stop-loss/trailing-stop orders, filling them atomically as price crosses tick boundaries.
